name: bettersuno-mcp
description: MCP server for BetterSuno — exposes Suno API features to AI agents via the Model Context Protocol

scripts.publish:patch: npm version patch --no-git-tag-version && git tag v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") && git push origin v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")
scripts.publish:minor: npm version minor --no-git-tag-version && git tag v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") && git push origin v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")
